ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Saakshi uses the camera to record photos and videos for your own records. They are fingerprinted and signed on your phone.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Saakshi records sound with your videos, for your own records.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Saakshi adds where a photo or video was taken to its record, and to messages you choose to send.
